studio_description: The Alora Comfort Sleeper pairs a tailored low-profile silhouette with American Leather's patented platform, a true bed in every size, no bar, no springs, ready in seconds.
The Alora Today Sleeper brings the Alora silhouette to a quick-ship sleeper format, hand-built in Dallas and ready for daily living and overnight guests alike.
The Blake Recliner reimagines the recliner as architecture, tailored, low-slung, engineered with whisper-quiet power, USB, and an optional battery so it sits anywhere in the room.
The Gaines Comfort Sleeper carries a soft contemporary frame with welt-trimmed seats and a true mattress beneath, a sofa first, a guest bed in seconds.
The Perry Comfort Sleeper layers loose back cushions over a clean track arm, hiding American Leather's patented sleep platform inside a piece that simply reads as a great sofa.
Eight contour zones per side, AI Sleep Concierge, Silent Wake, plush soft-to-medium-firm.
PRO smart features with premium gel memory foam for medium-to-firm cradle.
Smart bed with active pressure relief, adjustable comfort medium-soft to medium-firm.
Dual-articulating, wall-hugging, app-synced adjustable base built for Bryte smart beds.
Soy comfort layers over dual soy support, hand tufted with highest gauge pocketed coils.
Pillow top surface with soy comfort layers, hand tufted and handcrafted in NC.
Plush soy comfort over dual soy support, hand tufted with highest gauge pocketed coils.
Lofted box top over 5.5in 100% natural Talalay latex, hand tufted in NC.
3in 100% natural Talalay latex over highest gauge pocketed coils, hand tufted in NC.
Plush 100% natural Talalay top over highest gauge pocketed coils, hand tufted in NC.
